source: SHAARP.si Mathematica input mapping for Python solver-stage benchmark cases

convention.python_orientation: 3x3 real orientation matrix stored in solver_stage_benchmarks_v1.json
convention.shaarp_si_a: Transpose[python_orientation] so that a.epsilon_crystal.Transpose[a] reconstructs epsilon_lab
convention.dold: Computed so SHAARP.si dSHG rotation with a reconstructs benchmark d_voigt_lab.
convention.polarizer_angle_deg: s -> 90, p -> 0, matching EIw = {Cos[angle], Sin[angle], 0} before sample tilt.

notes: This file maps Python benchmark inputs into SHAARP.si variable names; it does not run Mathematica.
Every tensor conversion includes a reconstruction residual so convention mistakes are visible.
The a/epsilon/d convention must still be checked against Mathematica values before claiming agreement.
